researchNotes: franciskurkdjian.com and Galeries Lafayette returned 403. Names and concentrations from one retailer listing (page 1 of 2; some entries sold out there); no notes shown there so notes left empty. Not exhaustive. Round 2: franciskurkdjian.com returned 403 to direct fetch; notes come from Nordstrom product pages (tiers as Nordstrom prints them, which differ in places from the brand's own 'aura' wording). Aqua Celestia and Aqua Vitae Cologne Forte notes come from a Nordstrom set page that gives prose only.

fragrances.name: Kurky

sources.name: Zgo Perfumery — Maison Francis Kurkdjian collection
Scento — Kurky
Vivir — Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky
Venba — Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky EDP
Nordstrom — Maison Francis Kurkdjian Kurky Eau de Parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir 2025 review scores longevity 3.0 and projection 2.0 out of 5, and calls it a whisper. Scento's user aggregate says moderate longevity and moderate projection, so I set sillage to 2 because the majority of its sources say light. Venba recommends it for spring and summer, casual daytime wear (usage).
